title: Claro Home Launcher
shortDescription: Big buttons. Less fuss. A familiar home screen with calls and messages.
fullDescription:
Big buttons. Less fuss.

Claro Home Launcher brings the things you use every day into a clear, familiar home screen. Choose your favorite theme and keep everyday essentials easy to find.

MAKE HOME YOUR OWN
Add shortcuts for contacts, installed apps, camera, gallery and other everyday essentials. Reorder your home tiles and choose which apps appear in Claro's menu.

CALL AND MESSAGE WITH CLARITY
Use Claro as your default phone and SMS app to make calls, see recent and missed calls, read messages and write replies. Large controls and recognizable contact photos help keep the next action clear.

CHOOSE YOUR FAVORITE THEME
Make Claro feel like your phone with the look and layout that suit you. Switch themes in Settings without starting your setup again.

SET UP TOGETHER
Protect settings from accidental changes with a date question, or choose a caregiver PIN with a recovery secret. Adjust text size and choose English, Spanish or Hebrew, including right-to-left layouts.

A SHORTCUT TO SOMEONE YOU TRUST
Configure an SOS contact shortcut with a cancellable countdown before calling your chosen person. This is a regular phone call, not an emergency-response or monitoring service, and it does not guarantee that anyone will answer. Use your device's emergency calling options when needed.

ANDROID REQUIREMENTS
For Android 10 and newer. Claro requests the default Home, Phone and SMS roles for its launcher, calling and messaging features. Contacts, call history, messages, notifications and photos require the relevant Android permissions. Camera, alarm and third-party app shortcuts open apps already on your device. Calls and messages depend on your device, carrier and service; charges may apply.

You stay in control of Android permissions and can change your default apps in Android Settings.
